kind_note: Major Harappan city in Kutch; Bisht ASI seasons 1989–2005; UNESCO 2021

summary.zh: 卡奇卡迪尔岛大型哈拉帕城市；Bisht ASI 十四季发掘报告（2015 草稿）记录城堡/中城/下城、城墙、水库与大号文字符号；2021 年教科文登录（遗产命名≠考古定论）。
summary.en: Large Harappan city on Khadir Island (Kutch): Bisht ASI draft report (2015) documents citadel/middle/lower town, fortifications, reservoirs, and large script signs; UNESCO inscribed 2021 (heritage title ≠ archaeological verdict).
